description: Guide a student to implement a multi-timeframe strategy on LEAN that uses 4h bars for trend direction and 1h bars for precise entry timing, applied across the full 635-symbol Tier 2 universe. The student must learn to use LEAN's Consolidate() to build 4h bars from 1h data, manage per-symbol dual-timeframe indicator state, and ensure 4h indicators only update on 4h bar completion. Running this at scale across 635 symbols with 4 years of hourly data tests both correctness and performance.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I heard professional traders use multiple timeframes. I have hourly data for 635 crypto futures and I want to use a 4-hour trend to guide my hourly entries. How do I set this up on LEAN?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need to implement a multi-timeframe strategy on LEAN across 635 symbols: 4h EMA for trend, 1h RSI for entries. How do I set up consolidators for multiple symbols simultaneously?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm implementing a multi-timeframe strategy on LEAN across the full 635-symbol hourly universe. What's the right architecture for consolidators and per-symbol state?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student produces a LEAN C# algorithm that (1) subscribes to all 635 symbols at hourly resolution and consolidates to 4h bars per symbol, (2) computes 20-period EMA on 4h bars and RSI on 1h bars per symbol, (3) implements multi-timeframe entry/exit logic independently per symbol, (4) ensures 4h indicators update only on 4h bar completion, (5) manages per-symbol position state, and (6) produces per-symbol trade logs and universe summary. Trade logs for 5 reference symbols should match the ground-truth.
required_capabilities: Subscribe to multiple symbols at hourly resolution and use Consolidate() to create 4h bars per symbol
Manage per-symbol dual-timeframe indicator state (Dictionary of EMA + RSI per symbol)
Implement multi-timeframe logic: 4h trend filter gates 1h entry signals, per symbol
Ensure 4h indicators only update on 4h bar completion (avoid mid-period artifacts)
Manage per-symbol position state with position sizing across multiple active positions
Produce per-symbol and universe-level results from a multi-timeframe multi-asset backtest
